gmcm.ThrowKey.name: ThrowKey
gmcm.ThrowKey.tooltip: The key to hold to initiate a throw when required by certain loved ones, according to their type and/or the toggle settings.
gmcm.UseKeyForChildren.name: UseKeyForChildren
gmcm.UseKeyForChildren.tooltip: Require use of the ThrowKey to throw children, instead of automatically proceeding.
gmcm.UseKeyForPets.name: UseKeyForPets
gmcm.UseKeyForPets.tooltip: Require use of the ThrowKey to throw pets, instead of automatically proceeding.
gmcm.Blocklist.name: Blocklist
gmcm.Blocklist.tooltip: Comma-separated list. Specify animal types, pet types or breeds, child types, or character names to prevent being able to toss certain loved ones.
